image_prompt: Frederick William 'Stumpy', a cyberpunk anime interpretation of an 18th-century Prussian king. A diminutive male figure with an extremely compact, stocky build—his short stature emphasized by broad shoulders and a barrel chest. Sharp, angular facial features with stern, piercing eyes conveying unwavering military authority. Strong jawline, thin lips pressed into a determined line. Dark hair styled in a severe, geometric cyberpunk undercut with metallic silver highlights. Pale complexion with austere, rigid expression. Dressed in a futuristic militaristic uniform: a high-collared coat in deep prussian blue with neon blue piping and geometric circuit-like patterns running along the edges. Angular brass or gold metallic armor plating on shoulders and chest bearing Lutheran cross insignia with technological elements. Formal military buttons rendered as glowing digital interface points. Hands appear slightly augmented with subtle technological details. An aura of cold precision and religious fervor, rendered with anime's characteristic sharp lines and cool color palette. No softness—every element reflects rigid discipline and cybernetic formality.
book_context: Catherine the Great: A Life (or similar biographical work on Catherine II)
